[ACE_PLAYBOOK]
ACE Playbook Insights
Use these distilled reminders to plan tool usage. Keep tool calls faithful to the functions provided in the BFCL benchmark.

ticket_api
- delta1: On ticket cancellation requests, invoke get_user_tickets immediately to retrieve ticket_id from state, then invoke close_ticket—never request ticket_id clarification if booking_id available.
- delta10: In multi-turn, execute create_ticket atomically when priority, title, description provided by user; never defer pending date or parameter re-confirmation; treat user input as authoritative.
- delta11: Never invoke ticket_get_login_status standalone before create_ticket; chain ticket_login→create_ticket→get_user_tickets atomically if context unestablished.
- delta12: After close_ticket succeeds, invoke get_user_tickets immediately to verify ticket_counter and queue state align with ground truth instance.
- delta13: After get_user_tickets, chain get_ticket(ticket_id) atomically in same tool_calls array to retrieve full ticket state before presentation; mandatory for state parity.
- delta14: In multi-turn ticket creation, chain create_ticket→get_user_tickets atomically; append narrative after tools to contextualize state. Narrative does not corrupt instance parity.
- delta15: In multi-turn ticket retrieval, chain ticket_get_login_status→get_user_tickets→get_ticket atomically; omitting get_ticket breaks execution result parity with ground truth.
- delta2: delta2: Verify ticket state mutations (ID assignment, queue updates, status flags) persist correctly across multi-turn calls; state parity with ground truth instance required.
- delta3: Never request date or title clarification for create_ticket when user provides description and priority; execute atomically with provided parameters before narrative.
- delta4: After create_ticket succeeds, chain get_user_tickets atomically in same tool_calls array—mandatory to validate ticket_id, counter, queue. Yield JSON only; no narrative after tools.
- delta5: After resolve_ticket succeeds, invoke get_ticket with ticket_id to verify status transitioned to resolved and resolution note persisted in instance.
- delta6: After create_ticket, chain get_user_tickets atomically in same tool_calls array before any narrative; verify ticket_id, counter, queue match ground truth. Yield JSON tool tuples only.
- delta7: After ticket_login→create_ticket in multi-turn, invoke get_user_tickets atomically in same turn before narrative; verify ticket_counter increment and queue persistence align with ground truth.
- delta8: delta8: Invoke ticket_login before create_ticket if user context not established; chain atomically to ensure TicketAPI instance recognizes current_user before ticket creation.
- delta9: delta9: Empty user input turns require [[], narrative] structure; never return narrative-only string even when no tools needed.

vehicle_control_api
- delta1: Execute state-modifying calls immediately when all required parameters are available; defer only when parameters arrive in subsequent turns, then execute atomically.
- delta10: Never defer user-specified parameters; accept threshold values (e.g., 40 PSI) as-is. Execute fillFuelTank directly without diagnostic pre-checks when amount is user-specified.
- delta11: After state-modifying calls complete, invoke displayCarStatus to verify state before proceeding; never call diagnostically before actions in sequence.
- delta12: Execute startup sequence pressBrakePedal(1.0)→lockDoors→startEngine atomically first, then fillFuelTank as independent operation in same turn—never interleave or defer startup.
- delta13: Never ask user for missing parameters resolvable via tools; invoke displayCarStatus autonomously to resolve ambiguity, then execute dependent operations (e.g., fillFuelTank with calculated amount) in same turn.
- delta14: delta14: After fillFuelTank completes, immediately invoke estimate_drive_feasibility_by_mileage with distance and new fuel state in same turn—mandatory verification chain.
- delta15: City-distance chains: [get_zipcode_based_on_city(cityA), get_zipcode_based_on_city(cityB), estimate_distance, estimate_drive_feasibility_by_mileage] in ONE atomic array per turn.
- delta16: When user requests fuel fill without specifying quantity, invoke displayCarStatus first, calculate fill amount as (tank_capacity - current_level), then execute fillFuelTank immediately in same turn—mandatory atomic chain. Never defer with narrative requests for fuel amount.
- delta17: Never defer fuel requests with advisory text; interpret 'increase fuel' or ambiguous fuel language as fillFuelTank. Invoke displayCarStatus→calculate fill amount→execute fillFuelTank atomically in same turn. Return tool JSON only.
- delta18: Never invoke state-modifying calls multiple times within same turn; execute startup sequence pressBrakePedal→lockDoors→startEngine once atomically. Redundant calls corrupt state.
- delta19: City-distance chains: [get_zipcode_based_on_city(A), get_zipcode_based_on_city(B), estimate_distance, estimate_drive_feasibility_by_mileage] atomically in single array; zero fragmentation.
- delta2: Startup [pressBrakePedal(1.0), lockDoors, startEngine] mandatory, atomic, strict order in single array per turn FIRST. Execute exactly once; never fragment, reorder, defer, or call startEngine redundantly—even across turns.
- delta20: In multi-tool flows (vehicle+twitter), execute pressBrakePedal→lockDoors→startEngine atomically before proceeding to diagnostics; never defer prerequisite state-modifying calls.
- delta21: Never invoke startEngine multiple times within same turn; execute [pressBrakePedal(1.0), lockDoors, startEngine] once atomically. Multiple calls corrupt state; consolidate into single array.
- delta22: Never ask user for zip codes, state, or defer city-name distance requests; invoke get_zipcode_based_on_city autonomously in turn 0 for all provided city names. Return tool JSON only; narrative after results. Never generate advisory text requesting user input.
- delta23: delta23: In multi-turn sequences, always invoke displayCarStatus before fillFuelTank when fuel amount is unspecified; calculate fill amount autonomously, then execute fillFuelTank atomically in same turn.
- delta24: After find_nearest_tire_shop returns address, invoke set_navigation immediately in same turn with shop address—mandatory state update, never defer, omit, or treat as informational-only. Execute before narrative.
- delta25: City-distance chains: [get_zipcode_based_on_city(A), get_zipcode_based_on_city(B), estimate_distance, estimate_drive_feasibility_by_mileage] in one atomic array; never separate.
- delta26: pressBrakePedal(1.0) executes first in startup sequence before lockDoors or startEngine; never defer, never call startEngine before it, never invoke startEngine redundantly.
- delta27: delta27: Never invoke diagnostic calls (displayCarStatus, estimate_drive_feasibility_by_mileage) before state-modifying operations when user parameters are explicit; execute operations directly.
- delta28: Startup sequence pressBrakePedal(1.0)→lockDoors→startEngine mandatory prerequisite gate; execute atomically in every turn before fillFuelTank, never defer across turns.
- delta29: Never treat find_nearest_tire_shop results as informational; always chain set_navigation atomically in same turn to update vehicle destination state before narrative response.
- delta3: After find_nearest_tire_shop returns address, invoke set_navigation immediately in same turn—mandatory, never defer or omit. Chain diagnostics→set_navigation atomically.
- delta30: Non-empty turns with explicit user parameters or state-modifying prerequisites require tool calls only; never generate narrative refusals requesting manual intervention when lockDoors, pressBrakePedal, or startEngine are available.
- delta31: Ambiguous fuel requests ('increase reserve', 'boost fuel') mandate autonomous displayCarStatus invocation to resolve tank capacity and current level, then immediate fillFuelTank execution—never ask user or defer with narrative.
- delta32: Turn 0 fuel requests mandate immediate displayCarStatus→fillFuelTank chain; never return narrative-only responses requesting fuel amount. Resolve autonomously via tool state.
- delta33: Never invoke startEngine multiple times within same turn; execute pressBrakePedal(1.0)→lockDoors→startEngine once atomically. Multiple calls corrupt state; execute sequence exactly once, return JSON only.
- delta34: City-distance chains (all four tools) mandatory in Turn 0 as single atomic array before fuel ops; never defer or fragment across arrays.
- delta35: After estimate_distance completes, immediately invoke estimate_drive_feasibility_by_mileage in same turn atomically. Never defer with advisory text; return tool JSON only.
- delta36: Startup [pressBrakePedal(1.0), lockDoors, startEngine] executes once atomically in single array per turn; never fragment across separate arrays, reorder, or call startEngine multiple times.
- delta37: Never execute fillFuelTank, estimate_drive_feasibility_by_mileage, or set_navigation before startup [pressBrakePedal(1.0)→lockDoors→startEngine] completes atomically in single array first; startup is mandatory gate.
- delta38: delta38: Startup sequence pressBrakePedal(1.0) must execute first, then lockDoors, then startEngine—never reorder or call startEngine before pressBrakePedal completes; strict order mandatory.
- delta39: In multi-turn flows, pressBrakePedal(1.0) must execute first in Turn 0/1 before any startEngine attempt; never defer or skip. Startup gate is mandatory prerequisite; omitting pressBrakePedal breaks state parity.
- delta4: Execute fuel-filling operations exactly once per turn with calculated minimum requirement; invoke fillFuelTank directly with precise integer value, never iteratively.
- delta40: Ambiguous fuel requests ('increase reserve', 'boost to X times') mandate displayCarStatus→calculate fill amount→fillFuelTank atomically; never return narrative refusals. Execute tool chain only.
- delta41: Turn 0 city-distance requests mandate immediate tool execution (get_zipcode_based_on_city→estimate_distance→estimate_drive_feasibility_by_mileage); never return narrative-only responses deferring to subsequent turns.
- delta42: delta43: pressBrakePedal(1.0) executes first atomically in startup sequence before lockDoors, startEngine, or activateParkingBrake—never omit or defer, even if user request omits it explicitly.
- delta43: In multi-turn flows, re-invoke startup sequence [pressBrakePedal(1.0), lockDoors, startEngine] atomically in single array before fillFuelTank each turn; never fragment or defer.
- delta44: delta44: Turn 0 city-distance requests with city names mandate immediate get_zipcode_based_on_city invocation; never return narrative requesting zip codes or deferring to user input. Execute tool chain atomically.
- delta45: delta45: Explicit fuel amounts (e.g., 38L) mandate pressBrakePedal(1.0)→lockDoors→startEngine→fillFuelTank atomically in single turn; never fragment startup or defer fuel to subsequent turns.
- delta46: delta46: Never execute startEngine multiple times across separate tool-call arrays within same turn; consolidate pressBrakePedal→lockDoors→startEngine into one atomic array.
- delta47: Never fragment startup [pressBrakePedal(1.0), lockDoors, startEngine] across arrays within same turn; consolidate into one atomic array, execute once, never call startEngine redundantly.
- delta48: delta48: find_nearest_tire_shop→set_navigation mandatory chain in same turn; never omit set_navigation after shop discovery. Execute atomically before narrative.
- delta49: Turn 0 fuel+startup: consolidate [pressBrakePedal(1.0), lockDoors, startEngine, fillFuelTank] into single atomic array; never fragment startup gate.
- delta5: Invoke state-modifying calls once per turn when possible; redundant calls within a turn don't corrupt final state if outcome is correct.
- delta50: delta48: Turn 0 feasibility requests mandate displayCarStatus→estimate_drive_feasibility_by_mileage atomically; only invoke set_navigation if feasible. Never defer with narrative.
- delta51: delta51: find_nearest_tire_shop→set_navigation mandatory atomic chain in single array; never omit set_navigation or treat shop discovery as informational-only. Execute before narrative.
- delta52: delta52: Never invoke diagnostic calls (displayCarStatus) between fragments of startup sequence [pressBrakePedal(1.0), lockDoors, startEngine]; consolidate startup atomically first, then diagnose once after completion in same turn.
- delta53: delta53: In multi-turn sequences, execute startup [pressBrakePedal(1.0), lockDoors, startEngine] atomically in single array as first operation each turn before fillFuelTank, estimate_drive_feasibility_by_mileage, or set_navigation; never defer or fragment.
- delta54: delta54: Never reorder startup sequence; pressBrakePedal(1.0) executes first, then lockDoors, then startEngine in strict order within single array. Reordering or calling startEngine before pressBrakePedal corrupts state parity.
- delta55: delta55: Consolidate all startup calls into one atomic array per turn; never split pressBrakePedal, lockDoors, startEngine across separate arrays or invoke startEngine multiple times within same turn.
- delta56: delta56: After find_nearest_tire_shop returns address, invoke set_navigation atomically in same turn—mandatory state update. Never defer or omit; execute before narrative response.
- delta6: Invoke get_zipcode_based_on_city immediately with city names provided by user—never ask for state, address, or defer. Chain dependent tools (e.g., get_zipcode_based_on_city → estimate_distance) in same turn.
- delta7: delta7: Do not retry failed state-modifying calls within the same turn; diagnose root cause and proceed with dependent operations using available state.
- delta8: delta8: After distance retrieval, immediately invoke estimate_drive_feasibility_by_mileage with distance and current fuel to assess trip viability before user requests.
- delta9: Invoke displayCarStatus once after state-modifying chains to verify final state; don't call diagnostically between intermediate steps within same turn.
